blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Interactive agents repeatedly choose among a finite set of actions, labels, or ordinal outcomes. Generating a free-form response for each choice adds latency and complicates the interface between a model and its environment. We present Intern-Decision, a family of 0.8B, 2B, and 4B multimodal decision models that return structured choices and candidate probabilities from text and optional images. Our autoregressive masked language modeling objective places one decision placeholder per field in a complete assistant JSON skeleton. Ground-truth symbols appear only in supervision, while all fields are evaluated in a single causal forward pass using the backbone's native language-model head. The 4B model achieves a 90.02% unweighted average accuracy across seven evaluation suites, compared with 88.74% for Jev v1.13.0. For a fixed 289-token request with three fields on one RTX 4090, mean latency is 44.16 ms for the 4B model and approximately 33--34 ms for the smaller models. On a separate 96-case known-distribution pilot, temperature scaling reduces expected multiclass Brier from 0.628 to 0.550 and expected calibration error from 0.213 to 0.089. A confidence-based handoff study on 111 public Jevbench-Hard items improves accuracy from 82/111 (73.87%) to 97/111 (87.39%) by routing 42 items to Atria-Dawn-Preview. We also describe qualitative game, visual interface, and browser demonstrations. These results support compact decision models as a practical component of larger agent systems.
blocks.zh: 互动代理人在一组有限的动作,标签,或平分结果中反复选择. 生成每种选择的自由式响应会增加耐久性,使模型及其环境之间的接口复杂化. 我们提出实习决定,这是一个由0.8B、2B和4B多种模式组成的家庭,它们从文字和可选图像中返回结构化选择和候选概率。 我们自发的蒙面语言模型设计目标 将每个字段一个决定占位符置于一个完整的助理JSON骨架中. 地面真实符号只在监督中出现,而所有字段都使用主干部的本土语言模式头进行单一的因果前传评价. 4B模式在7个评价套件中实现了90.02%的未加权平均精度,而Jev v1.13.0. 对于一个有3个字段的固定的289个托肯请求,在一个RTX 4090上,4B型号的平均耐用度为44.16 ms,较小的型号大约为33-34 ms. 在单独的96例已知分流试验中,温度缩放将预期的多级布列尔从0.628降至0.550并预期校正出错从0.213降至0.089. 对111个公开的Jevbench-Hard项目进行了基于信任的交接研究,通过将42个项目运往Atria-Dawn-Preview,提高了准确性,从82/111(73.87%)提高到97/111(87.39%)。 我们还描述了定性游戏,视觉界面,以及浏览器演示. 这些成果支持作为较大代理系统实际组成部分的紧凑决策模式。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Driven by the rapid progress of large language models (LLMs), agent systems have evolved from passive text generation models into interactive systems capable of perceiving environments, using tools, and taking actions [ 30 , 19 , 32 ] .
Unlike open-ended text generation, many agent operations are inherently closed-set decision problems, where the model selects from a predefined set of alternatives, such as tool invocation, model routing, and actions [ 20 ] .
However, current agents often rely on autoregressive free-form generation even when the underlying task only requires structured decisions, introducing additional decoding overhead and complicating the interface between models and downstream controllers [ 30 , 19 , 25 ] .
These observations motivate the development of dedicated decision models that can directly produce structured outcomes together with reliable confidence estimates for efficient agent execution.
blocks.zh:
在大语言模型(LLMs)的快速进步的推动下,代理系统从被动文本生成模型发展成为能够透视环境,使用工具,并采取行动[30,19,32]的互动系统.
与开放式文本生成不同,许多代理操作本质上是封闭的设定决定问题,模型从预先定义的一组替代品中选择,如工具引用,模型路由,和行动[20].
然而,目前的代理往往依赖自旋式自由形式生成,即使基础任务只需要有条理的决定,引入额外的解码间接费用,使模型与下游控制器之间的接口复杂化[30,19,25].
这些观察促使制定专门的决策模式,这种模式可以直接产生结构化的结果,同时对有效的代理执行进行可靠的信任估计。

blocks.en:
Recent work on structured decision models, referred to as System-1 decision models, explores this perspective by replacing unrestricted generation with explicit decision interfaces and probabilistic outputs.
Systems such as Jev [ 27 ] provide typed interfaces for choice, score, and binary decisions, while several open implementations investigate alternative architectures and inference strategies for efficient structured decision making [ 1 , 17 , 26 , 22 ] .
These interfaces primarily target textual decisions, and implementations differ in whether they score multiple questions jointly or separately.
For multimodal agents operating in dynamic environments, decision models must additionally integrate visual observations, task instructions, and changing interface states, where action selection depends jointly on visual evidence and contextual constraints [ 29 , 28 ] .
Moreover, practical agent requests often require multiple decisions over a shared state, creating a need for efficient multi-field decision models that can preserve the capabilities of pretrained multimodal language models while providing structured outputs.
blocks.zh:
最近关于结构化决策模型的工作称为System-1决策模型,通过以明确的决策界面和概率产出取代无限制生成来探索这一视角.
Jev[27]等系统为选择,评分和二进制决定提供打字界面,而一些公开执行则调查替代架构和推论策略,以高效的结构化决策[1,17,26,22].
这些界面主要针对文本决定,执行时在对多个问题进行联合或单独评分上有所不同.
对于在动态环境中运作的多式联运代理商,决策模型必须额外整合视觉观测,任务指令,以及不断变化的界面状态,其中动作选择共同依赖于视觉证据和背景限制[29,28].
此外,实际代理请求往往需要就共享状态作出多重决定,从而需要高效率的多领域决定模式,既能保持预先培训的多式联运模式的能力,又能提供结构化的产出。

blocks.en:
To address these challenges, we introduce Intern-Decision , a family of multimodal decision models based on autoregressive masked language modeling .
Our approach reformulates structured decision making as next-token prediction over masked decision fields within a predefined assistant output schema.
By retaining the pretrained causal language model backbone and native language-model head, Intern-Decision evaluates multiple candidate decisions in a single forward pass and produces both structured predictions and candidate probabilities without iterative text generation.
This design separates decision scoring from free-form response decoding, enabling efficient inference while preserving compatibility with existing multimodal language models.
blocks.zh:
为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了实习决定,这是一个基于自发的蒙面语言模式的多模式决定模式的大家庭。
我们的方法重构了结构化决策,作为预先确定的助理输出计划内,在蒙蔽的决策领域之上的下一个预测。
通过保留预先训练的因果语言模型骨干和本土语言模型头,实习决定用一次前传评价多个候选人决定,并产生结构化预测和候选人概率,而无需迭代文本生成.
这种设计将决策评分与自由格式的响应解码区分开来,在保持与现有多式联运模式的兼容性的同时,能够有效推论.

blocks.en:
To adapt pretrained models to this decision-oriented interface, we construct a unified multimodal decision corpus consisting of textual states, optional images, typed questions, and target decisions.
The corpus combines teacher-constructed challenging decisions with public task distributions, covering textual reasoning, instruction-following decisions, visual judgments, interface actions, and interactive control scenarios.
We instantiate Intern-Decision with 0.8B, 2B, and 4B Qwen3.5 backbones [ 23 ] , fine-tuning the language backbone while keeping the vision tower and projector frozen.
To improve the reliability of confidence estimates, we further apply post-hoc temperature scaling [ 13 ] using a separate calibration split.
blocks.zh:
为使预先训练的模型适应这种面向决定的界面,我们构建了一套统一的多式联运决定书,其中包括文字状态、可选图像、打字问题和目标决定。
教程将教师构建的具有挑战性的决定与公共任务分配相结合,涵盖文字推理、教学后续决定、视觉判断、界面行动和互动控制情景。
我们用0.8B,2B,和4B的Quen3.5骨干进行即时裁判,微调语言骨干,同时保持视觉塔和投影机的冻结.
为了提高置信估计的可靠性,我们进一步使用单独的校准分解法,采用热后温度缩放[13].

blocks.en:
We evaluate Intern-Decision from three perspectives: decision accuracy, inference efficiency, and probability quality.
Across seven evaluation suites, including public Jevbench subsets [ 10 ] , Intern-Decision-4B achieves a 90.02% unweighted mean accuracy, compared with 88.74% for Jev.
For a fixed 289-token request containing three decision fields, Intern-Decision-4B achieves a mean latency of 44.16 ms on a single RTX 4090.
We further evaluate probability calibration through a separate known-distribution pilot and study confidence-based model routing, in which requests are passed to a larger model when the decision model’s confidence falls below a threshold.
Qualitative demonstrations on visual interaction and browser assistance further illustrate how compact decision models can serve as local decision modules within hierarchical agent systems.
blocks.zh:
我们从三个角度评价实习决定:决定的准确性、推断效率和概率质量。
包括公共Jevbench子集在内的7套评价套件[10],实习生决定-4B的无加权平均准确度为90.02%,而Jev的为88.74%。
对于包含三个决定领域的289个固定请求,实习决定-4B在单张RTX 4090上实现了44.16毫秒的中延.
我们进一步通过一个单独的已知分配试点来评估概率校准,并研究基于信任的模型路径,其中当决策模型的信心低于门槛时,将请求传递给更大的模型。
关于视觉互动和浏览器协助的定性演示进一步说明了紧凑决策模型如何可作为等级代理系统中的本地决策模块.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We introduce Intern-Decision , a family of compact multimodal decision models that formulate structured decision making as next-token-aligned masked prediction, enabling multi-field candidate scoring with a native language-model head in a single causal forward pass. • We develop a unified multimodal decision framework, evaluate accuracy, latency, and calibration under separate protocols, and illustrate visual interaction through qualitative demonstrations. • We investigate confidence-based model handoff that passes low-confidence requests to a larger model, and demonstrate how compact structured decision models can complement larger models in interactive agent systems.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献概述如下: 我们提出实习决定,这是一套紧凑的多式联运决定模式,将结构化的决策作为下一个托肯式的蒙面预测,使多战区候选人能够以单一的因果前传获得当地语言模式头的评分。 我们制定统一的多式联运决策框架,根据单独的协议评估准确性、耐久性和校准性,并通过定性演示说明视觉互动。 我们调查将低信心请求传递给更大模型的基于信心的模型移交,并展示紧凑结构化决策模型如何在交互式代理系统中补充更大的模型。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Recent decision models target fast, structured judgments: given a state, questions, and predefined answer options, they return typed decisions with probability estimates rather than free-form text.
Alongside TypeSafe’s Jev [ 27 ] , which supports choice, score, and binary decisions and reports using Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions (RLCD), related open implementations explore different modeling and inference strategies for structured decision-making.
JevK5 [ 1 ] adapts Qwen3.5 with LoRA and derives candidate probabilities from next-token logits through a Jev-style interface.
Kev [ 17 ] combines Qwen backbones with LoRA adapters and a learned pointer head, providing self-hostable models and an API for typed choices and scores.
SemIf-OpenJev [ 26 ] provides a direct-scoring approach that derives option probabilities from candidate-token logits of frozen language models, with optional shared-state prefill reuse across questions.
Laya [ 22 ] adopts an encoder-based, non-autoregressive architecture to produce choice, score, and yes/no decisions in a single forward pass.
Within this paradigm, Intern-Decision focuses on multimodal structured decision-making, incorporating visual inputs alongside textual states and task instructions.
blocks.zh:
近期的决定模型针对快速,结构化的判断:给定一个状态,问题,以及预先定义的答案选项,它们会以概率估计而不是自由格式文本返回打字的决定.
TypeSafe的Jev [27] 支持选择、分数和二进制决定,
JevK5 [1] 与 LORA 一起适应 Quen3.5 ,并通过 Jev 风格的接口从邻接的日志中获取候选概率.
Kev [17] 组合 具有LORA适配器和学习指针头的Quen骨干,为打字选择和打分提供可自宿模式和API.
SemIf-OpenJev [26] 提供了一种直接评分的方法,从冷冻语言模型的候选对数中得出选项概率,可选择共享状态预填再使用跨问题.
Laya [22] 采用基于编码器的,非自动递归的架构,以产生选择,得分,在一次前传中是/否决定.
在这一范式中,实习决定侧重于多式联运结构化决策,将视觉投入与文本状态和任务指示相结合。

blocks.en:
Autoregressive language models such as GPT-3 [ 5 ] predict tokens conditioned on a causal prefix, whereas BERT [ 8 ] reconstructs masked tokens using bidirectional context.
Hybrid approaches explore combinations of these paradigms: UniLMv2 [ 3 ] combines autoencoding and partially autoregressive objectives through pseudo masking, while GLM [ 9 ] combines bidirectional encoding of the corrupted input with autoregressive reconstruction of masked spans.
Mask-Predict [ 12 ] predicts masked target tokens in parallel and iteratively refines uncertain predictions.
For classification, PET [ 24 ] uses pattern–verbalizer pairs for cloze-based prediction and distills the resulting models into a sequence classifier, while LM-BFF [ 11 ] performs prompt-based fine-tuning with label words and demonstrations, reusing the pretrained masked-language-model head.
Intern-Decision formulates structured decisions as autoregressive masked language modeling , combining answer placeholders with next-token-aligned prediction in a causal multimodal model.
Its native language-model head scores candidates for all requested fields in a single forward pass, without iterative refinement or answer feedback.
blocks.zh:
GPT-3[5]等自动递减语言模型预测以因果前缀为条件的符号,而BERT[8]则利用双向上下文重建蒙面符号.
混合方法探索这些范式的组合: UniLMv2[3]通过假面具将自动编码和部分自递目标结合起来,而GLM[9]则将腐败输入的双向编码与自递重建遮盖跨度结合起来.
Mask-President [12] 平行预测蒙面目标符,迭代完善不确定的预测.
对于分类,PET [24] 使用图案 - 语言对子进行血凝胶的预测,并将产生的模型蒸馏成序列分类器,而LM-BFF [11] 则用标签单词和演示来进行即时的微调,重新使用预先训练过的蒙面语言模型头.
Intern-Decision将结构化决定作为自动的蒙面语言模型制定,将答案占位符和下接键的预测结合到因果多式联运模型中。
其本土语言模型头部对所有请求字段的考生进行单向前传的评分,没有迭代完善或回答反馈.

blocks.en: Temperature scaling fits a positive scalar to adjust predictive confidence while preserving the most likely label [ 13 ] . Brier scoring evaluates the full predictive distribution [ 4 ] , complementing accuracy and binned calibration error. Confidence-based routing and cascading use uncertainty to allocate requests between models with different costs [ 6 , 7 ] . Our evaluation separates hard-label calibration from an exact-distribution pilot and reports one escalation operating point rather than an optimized routing policy.
blocks.zh: 温度缩放符合正滑板以调整预测置信度,同时保留最可能的标签[13]. Brier评分评价了完整的预测分布[4],补充了准确性和binned校准错误. 基于信心的路由和串联利用不确定性在成本不同的模型之间分配请求[6,7]. 我们的评价将硬标签校准与精确分配试点分开,并报告一个升级操作点,而不是优化路线政策。

blocks.en: 3.2 Input construction and causal readout
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 输入构建和因果读出

blocks.en: The released compiler places the state and ordered decision schema in the user turn, then appends an assistant JSON skeleton with one reserved <decision> token per field. Figure 1 presents a readable view of a constructed support-ticket request with choice , score , and noul fields. Choice symbols follow criteria order, score symbols follow list order from 0 , and Boolean symbols are A for no and B for yes . The target panel shows the mapped answer symbols A , C , and B , corresponding to billing , urgency 2 , and yes . Training supervises these symbol tokens at the decision positions; inference maps predicted symbols back to the original labels. The displayed JSON groups the supervision targets for illustration and is not inserted into the input or supervised as a complete generated JSON response.

blocks.en: 3.5 Computational scope

blocks.en: The method removes iterative answer decoding and avoids separate field-by-field forward passes. It does not eliminate the cost of processing the input: longer states, more image tokens, and larger schemas still increase computation and memory. One request may yield multiple decisions, so request rate and decision rate are different quantities. Causal ordering also means fields can have different contextual prefixes even when they share a forward pass; the construction does not enforce permutation invariance or a jointly constrained output distribution.
blocks.zh: 该方法取消了迭代的答案解码,并避免了单独的逐字段前传通行证. 它并没有消除处理输入的成本:更长的状态,更多的图像符号,更大的计划仍然增加计算和内存. 一个请求可能会产生多个决定,因此请求率和决定率是不同的数量. causal 订购也意味着字段可以有不同的上下文前缀,即使它们共享了前传;构造不会执行变异的穿透或共同限制的输出分布.

blocks.en: 4.1 Decision-oriented data construction

blocks.en: The decision corpus teaches structured choices rather than free-form answers. It combines synthetic textual decisions, public task distributions, and synthetic visual and interactive tasks. Each example contains a visible state, optional images, typed questions, and target labels, allowing these sources to share the same decision interface.
blocks.zh: 裁决书教授的是结构化的选择,而不是自由形式的答案。 它结合合成文字决定,公共任务分配,以及合成视觉和交互任务. 每个实例都包含一个可见状态,可选的图像,打出的问题,以及目标标签,使这些来源可以共享相同的决定界面.

blocks.en: 4.2 Calibration test set construction
blocks.zh: 4.2 校准试验装置的建造

blocks.en: This evaluation-only test set measures whether the model assigns appropriate probabilities to all possible outcomes of a stated random experiment. For example, a fair die requires probability 1 / 6 1/6 on each real face and zero on impossible faces. Selecting one plausible face does not establish a correct predictive distribution. Similarly, the Monty Hall questions ask where the prize is, with doors as outcomes; they do not ask whether switching is the best action.
blocks.zh: 这一只评估的测试设定了模型是否为所声明的随机实验的所有可能结果分配适当概率的尺度. 例如,一个公平的死亡要求每个真实面孔的概率为1/61/6,不可能面孔的概率为0. 选择一个可信的面孔不能确定正确的预测分布。 同样,Monty Hall询问奖金在哪里,门作为结果;他们不问切换是否是最好的行动。

blocks.en: The set is constructed from 24 mechanism families in six categories. Each family has two settings, which vary numerical parameters or the observation protocol. Each setting is emitted with canonical and reversed option order, yielding 6 × 4 × 2 × 2 = 96 6\times 4\times 2\times 2=96 cases, 16 per category. The two order variants share the same state, question, and reference distribution. There are therefore 48 paired settings rather than 96 independent trials. Appendix C gives the family inventory and concrete input/reference examples.
blocks.zh: 该套由24个机制家庭组成,分为6类。 每个家族有两个设置,这些设置会改变数值参数或观测协议. 每个设置均以条形并反转的选项顺序排出,产生6×4×2×2×2=96 6\时 4×2×96例,每类16例. 两个顺序变体具有相同的状态,问题和参考分布. 因此,有48个配对环境,而不是96个独立审判。 附 录 C提供了家庭清单和具体投入/参考实例。

blocks.en: For each setting, a deterministic Python generator specifies the sample space, priors, independence assumptions, and observation or selection mechanism. It computes the exact distribution using rational arithmetic: counting and enumeration for finite outcomes, conditional-probability formulas for observed evidence, a forward recursion for hidden states, and combinatorial or dynamic-programming calculations for sequential processes. References are not Monte Carlo estimates or model-generated answers. Construction checks enforce probabilities in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , an exact sum of one, matching option keys, unique IDs, and equivalent reversed-order pairs. Rebuilding from the archived generator reproduces the evaluated input and reference files byte for byte.
blocks.zh: 对于每个设置,一个定型Python生成器指定了样本空间,前身,独立假设,以及观测或选择机制. 它使用合理的算术计算准确的分布:计算和计数有限的结果,观测到的证据的有条件概率公式,隐藏状态的向前递减,以及顺序过程的组合或动态编程计算. 参考文献不是蒙特卡洛估计或模型生成的答案. 构造检查在 [0, 1] [0, 1] 中执行概率, 精确的和数为 1, 匹配选项密钥, 独一无二的ID, 和等效的反向顺序对 。 从存档生成器中重建复制评价的输入和引用文件字节用于字节.

blocks.en: Inputs contain only the state and typed questions. Exact fractions, numerical reference probabilities q i q_{i} , derivations, and provenance remain in a separate reference file and are never sent to the model. The set is not used to train the model, fit its temperature, or select a checkpoint. An exact-content check found no overlap with the temperature-fitting records; this check does not establish absence of semantic overlap with every training source.

blocks.en: In the actual three-door informed-host case, the prize is uniformly placed and the player initially selects door 1. A host who knows the prize location always opens an unchosen empty door and always offers the other unopened door; legal reveals are chosen uniformly. The input does not disclose the opened door’s number. The question is “Where is the prize relative to the final two unopened doors?” Its outcomes are initial_door and other_unopened_door , with reference probabilities 1 / 3 1/3 and 2 / 3 2/3 . The initial selection retains its prior probability, and the host’s guaranteed safe reveal concentrates the other 2 / 3 2/3 on the remaining door. An output concentrated entirely on the remaining door would select the more likely outcome but misrepresent the residual uncertainty.
blocks.zh: 在实际的三门知情主案中,奖金统一放置,玩家最初选择门 一、导 言 一个知道奖金地点的主持人总是打开一个未经选择的空门,总是提供另一个未打开的门;法律启示是统一选择的. 输入不透露打开的门的号码 。 问题是“与最后两个未打开的门相比,奖金在哪里?” 其结果为初始_门和其他未打开的_门,参考概率1/3 1/3和2/3 2/3。 最初的选择保留了先前的概率,东道主有保障的安全披露将其他的2 / 3 2/3 集中在剩余的门上. 产出完全集中在剩下的门上,将选择更可能的结果,但会歪曲剩余的不确定性。

blocks.zh: 每点报告都意味着在10个等宽箱中有一个箱内有最大扫描值的置信度和经验精确度. 空信箱被省略 。 曲线使用存档的预测统计而不是数字化的图像坐标. 连接行是描述性的:点对不同的bin进行概括,不通过校准设置追踪相同的项目.

blocks.en: The bins have unequal sample counts, including one Jev bin with a single item. Accordingly, the plot supports an aggregate calibration comparison but does not establish reliable behavior at every confidence level. No bin-level uncertainty intervals are available.

blocks.en: 5.3 Local inference latency
blocks.zh: 5.3 当地推断延迟

blocks.en: Local measurements use one RTX 4090, BF16, SDPA, the native Hugging Face backend, Transformers 5.14.1, and flash-linear-attention 0.4.2. Each request has 289 input tokens and three fields: one choice, one Boolean, and one ordinal question. All three are answered in one forward pass with checkpoint-specific temperature scaling. This is a fixed short-request measurement, not a latency sweep over long contexts or screenshots.
blocks.zh: 局部测量使用一台RTX 4090,BF16,SDPA,土生土长的Hugging Face后端,变形器5.14.1,以及闪光线-注意0.4.2. 每个请求有289个输入符和3个字段:一个选择,一个布尔,和一个正文问题. 三者都通过一个前行回答,并按具体检查站温度比例进行。 这是一种固定的短要求计量,而不是对长的上下文或截图进行耐久扫描。

blocks.en: Table 5: Reported request latency in milliseconds. Ratios are Jev mean divided by model mean. The supplied protocol establishes the local Intern-Decision configuration; Jev’s complete serving and transport conditions still require documentation.
blocks.zh: 表5:报告的请求延迟数以毫秒计。 比率为Jev平均值除以模型平均值. 提供的协议规定了本地实习决定配置;Jev的完整服务和运输条件仍需要文件。

blocks.en: The reciprocal mean latencies imply approximately 29.43, 30.05, and 22.64 serial requests per second for 0.8B, 2B, and 4B, respectively, assuming negligible additional loop overhead. These are derived request rates rather than measured saturated serving throughput. They do not imply the same frame rate for an interactive agent, which also incurs observation, image preprocessing, action execution, and environment-update costs. Batch size, warm-up, repetition count, timing boundaries, and Jev transport conditions are needed before interpreting the ratios as controlled hardware speedups.
blocks.zh: 对等平均延迟大约意味着每秒0.8B、2B和4B的串行请求约为29.43、30.05和22.64,假设额外循环间接费用可忽略不计。 这些是衍生的请求率,而不是测量的饱和服务吞吐量。 它们并不意味着交互式代理机的帧率相同,这也会产生观测、图像预处理、动作执行和环境更新费用。 批量大小,热身,重复计数,计时边界,以及Jev运输条件,在将比例解读为可控硬件加速前都需要.

blocks.en: 5.4 Known-distribution calibration pilot
blocks.zh: 5.4 已知分配校准试验

blocks.en: The known-distribution calibration test set constructed in Section 4.2 contains 96 cases across six categories. It evaluates complete outcome distributions against exact reference probabilities.
blocks.zh: 第4.2节中构建的已知分布校准测试套包括96个案例,分为6个类别。 它根据确切的参考概率来评价完整的结果分布。

blocks.en: The question wording requests an outcome, while the native decision interface returns a probability for every listed option. Intern-Decision maps the ordered options to legal answer tokens and applies the candidate softmax in Equation 3 ; Jev supplies its native API probability map. We score these complete distributions, rather than converting a selected label into a one-hot vector or counting how often repeated sampled answers occur. Normalization guarantees a probability vector, but correctness must be measured against q i q_{i} .
blocks.zh: 问题措辞要求结果,而本地决定界面则返回每个列出选项的概率. Intern-Decision 将命令选项映射到法律解答符上,并在方程式3中应用候选软max ; Jev 提供了其本地API概率图. 我们对这些完整的分布进行评分,而不是将一个选定的标签转换成一个一热矢量,或者计算重复抽样答案的发生频率. 常态化保证了概率矢量,但正确性必须对照q i q_{i}测量.

blocks.en: Table 6: Known-distribution pilot results. Each cell is expected Brier / expected ECE; bold marks the lowest value across the three settings for each metric separately. All settings have 96/96 valid predictions. Category rows have 16 cases each. Overall ECE is recomputed on the pooled cases, not averaged over categories.

blocks.en: The final 4B checkpoint is evaluated with a fixed XTuner backend and T = 1.992418 T=1.992418 , fitted on separate calibration records. Jev uses version 1.13.0. Temperature scaling reduces overall expected Brier by 0.078 and expected ECE by 0.124 while preserving every argmax. The calibrated model improves on its uncalibrated result in both metrics in all six categories. Relative to Jev, it has lower Brier in five categories and lower ECE in five categories; it is worse on Brier for selective disclosure and on ECE for daily evidence. Overall ECE differs from the mean category ECE because the cases are rebinned together.

blocks.en: For the informed-host three-door case described in Section 4.2 , calibrated Intern-Decision returns ( 0.4222 , 0.5778 ) (0.4222,0.5778) and Jev returns ( 0.18 , 0.82 ) (0.18,0.82) in that order. Both select the more likely door, while their total variation distances from the reference are 0.0889 and 0.1533, respectively. The uncalibrated 4B distribution ( 0.3486 , 0.6514 ) (0.3486,0.6514) is closer still, so the overall gain from temperature scaling does not imply improvement on every case. Jev also returns a separate confidence of 0.63 here, which is the value used by the pilot ECE protocol. Changing the observation mechanism changes the target: an uninformed host who randomly opens a door, conditioned on revealing no prize, yields ( 1 / 2 , 1 / 2 ) (1/2,1/2) . Appendix C also explains a selective-offer variant.
blocks.zh: 关于第4.2节所述的知情-东道三门案件,按此顺序调整了实习裁判的回函(0.4222、0.5778)(0.4222、0.5778)和Jev回函(0.18、0.82)(0.18、0.82)。 两者都选择更可能的门,而它们与参考文献的总变化距离分别为0.0889和0.1533. 未校准的4B分布(0.3486,0.6514)更接近(0.3486,0.6514),因此温度缩放的总体收益并不意味着每个病例都有改善. Jev在此还返回了0.63的单独置信度,这是欧洲经委会试验议定书所使用的价值。 改变观察机制改变目标:不知情的宿主随机打开一扇门,条件是不透露奖品,产量(1/2,1/2)(1/2,1/2). 附 录 C还解释了一种选择性报价的变体.

blocks.en: 5.5 Confidence-based model handoff
blocks.zh: 5.5 基于信任的模型交割

The reported study routes 42 of the 111 public Hard items to Atria-Dawn-Preview [ 16 ] , leaving 69 items with Intern-Decision-4B. The routed fraction is 37.84%, and local coverage is 62.16%.

Table 7: Public model handoff study on Jevbench-Hard. The hybrid time is an estimate, while the Atria-only total is reported as measured. The local total is derived from 111 times the fixed-request mean latency and is not a per-item Hard timing trace.

blocks.zh: 混合体比小模型正确回答15项,比阿特里亚单独回答2项. 与仅报告的阿特里亚总数相比,其估计时间减少了53.29%。 这表明一个可能有用的操作点,而不是既定的最佳政策。

blocks.en: 6 Multimodal Interaction and Model Collaboration
blocks.zh: 6 多式联运和模式合作

blocks.en: 6.1 A closed-loop decision interface
blocks.zh: 6.1 国家 闭路决定界面

blocks.en: In an interactive controller, each iteration observes an environment state, forms candidate actions, evaluates them, executes the selected action, and observes the result. Intern-Decision supplies the local choice within this loop. The caller defines the action space and determines when to request another decision. The following demonstrations illustrate this interface; they are selected qualitative trajectories rather than controlled benchmark measurements.
blocks.zh: 在交互式控制器中,每个迭代都观察环境状态,形成候选动作,评价动作,执行选定的动作,并观察结果. 实习决定在这个循环中提供本地选择. 呼叫者定义动作空间,并决定何时请求另一个决定. 以下演示说明了这一接口;它们是选定的定性轨迹,而不是受控制的基准测量。

blocks.en: 6.2 Visual game control
blocks.zh: 6.2 (中文(简体) ). 视觉游戏控制

blocks.en: Five described demonstrations span Snake, fruit catching, Mario, and two first-person Doom tasks. They require different local decisions: selecting a safe direction toward food, distinguishing fruit from hazards, coordinating movement and jumping, searching for health, or targeting an enemy. Screenshots provide visual evidence directly, so the controller can operate without converting every game state into a symbolic text description.
blocks.zh: 五个描述的演示 横跨蛇,水果捕获,马里奥, 和两个第一人称 末日任务 。 它们需要不同的当地决定:选择食物的安全方向,区分果实和危险,协调行动和跳跃,寻找健康,或瞄准敌人。 屏幕截图直接提供视觉证据,因此控制器可以操作,而不将每个游戏状态转换成象征性的文字描述.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Qualitative examples of visual game control with Intern-Decision. From left to right: navigating toward food while avoiding the snake body; catching fruit while avoiding bombs; moving and jumping through a Mario level; searching for health packs; and firing at approaching enemies. Each column shows two consecutive video frames, with the earlier frame on top and the later frame below.
blocks.zh: 图5 视觉游戏控制的定性实例与实习决定. 从左到右:在躲避蛇身的同时向食物方向航行;在躲避炸弹的同时捕捉水果;移动和跳过马里奥级;寻找健康包;向接近敌人射击. 每个栏目显示两个连续的视频帧,前面的帧在上方,后面的帧在下方.

blocks.en: In the Doom health-gathering example, the agent changes its view after contacting a wall and subsequently searches for new targets. This is an observed behavior in a trajectory; it is not evidence of a learned exploration objective or a general exploration algorithm. Episode counts, seeds, returns, action frequency, observation history, and comparison policies are required for quantitative conclusions about game competence. The short text-request timing in Table 5 does not establish visual-control frame rate.
blocks.zh: 在"末日健康收集"的例子中,代理商在接触墙后改变观点,随后搜索新的目标. 这是一种在轨迹中观察到的行为;它不是已学习的勘探目标或一般勘探算法的证据。 Episode计数,种子,回报,动作频率,观测历史,以及比较政策,都需要对游戏能力作出定量结论. 表5中的短文本请求时间没有确定视觉控制帧率.

blocks.en: 6.3 Visual selection and mouse actions
blocks.zh: 6.3 视觉选择和鼠标动作

blocks.en: CAPTCHA-style visual tasks require the integration of visual perception, instruction understanding, and interactive decision making. Intern-Decision directly observes interface screenshots, identifies targets described in natural language, and completes tasks through discrete mouse movements and clicks. The model must interpret object attributes and their relationships, translate visual judgments into executable actions, and use the updated screenshot after each action to guide the next decision, forming a closed loop between perception and execution.
blocks.zh: CAPTCHA风格的视觉任务需要整合视觉感知,教学理解,互动决策. Intern-Decision直接观察界面截图,识别自然语言描述的目标,并通过离散鼠标移动和点击完成任务. 模型必须解释对象属性及其关系,将视觉判断转化为可执行动作,并利用每次动作后更新的截图来指导下个决定,形成感知与执行之间的闭合循环.

blocks.en: Figure 6: Visual selection trajectories rendered as static video strips. Each row contains five chronologically ordered frames: (a) selecting the largest red sphere; (b) selecting the smallest red cube; (c) identifying the odd shape; and (d) selecting the second blue object from the left. Arrows indicate temporal progression, with intermediate steps omitted. Panels preserve the recorded object layouts and cursor positions; interface text is translated into English for presentation, and video presentation overlays are omitted.
blocks.zh: 图6:作为静态视频条提供的视觉选择轨迹. 每行包含五个按时间顺序排列的框架:(a) 选择最大的红色球体;(b) 选择最小的红色立方体;(c) 识别奇异形状;(d) 从左边选择第二个蓝色物体。 箭头表示时间进展,中间步骤省略. 面板保存所记录的对象布局和光标位置;界面文本翻译为英语进行演示,并省略视频演示叠加.

blocks.en: Four demonstrations record successful trajectories in which Intern-Decision autonomously completes the tasks; Figure 6 presents selected keyframes in chronological order. Guided by the task instruction and the current screenshot, the model progressively moves the pointer, adjusts its position, and clicks the target without human takeover or correction. These examples illustrate the integration of multimodal understanding with sequential action selection and provide a concrete experimental setting for studying visual interaction and task execution in graphical interfaces.
blocks.zh: 四次演示记录了成功的轨迹,其中实习决定自主地完成了任务; 图6按时间顺序列出了选定的键框. 在任务指示和当前截图的指引下,模型逐步移动指针,调整位置,点击目标而无需人机接管或纠正. 这些例子说明将多式联运理解与顺序动作选择相结合,并为研究图形界面中的视觉互动和任务执行提供了一个具体的实验环境。

blocks.en: 6.4 Hierarchical browser assistance
blocks.zh: 6.4 等级浏览器协助

blocks.en: We study browser use as hierarchical, closed-loop decision making rather than end-to-end free-form generation. Given a natural-language goal, a larger planner maintains cross-page context and proposes a stage-level subgoal. At each iteration, the current page evidence and a finite candidate set (e.g., click, scroll, return, or stop) are presented to Intern-Decision; the selected action is executed, and the page is observed again. The user task contains neither element identifiers nor a scripted click sequence, so local actions are chosen from the live interface.
blocks.zh: 我们研究浏览器作为分级,闭路决策使用,而不是端到端的自由形式生成. 鉴于一个自然语言的目标,一个较大的规划人员保持跨页环境,并提出一个阶段的次级目标。 在每次迭代时,都会向实习决定提交当前页面证据和一个有限的候选集(如点击,滚动,返回,或停止);执行选定的动作,并再次观察页面. 用户任务既不包含元素标识符,也不包含脚本点击序列,因此从直播界面中选择了本地动作.

blocks.en: Figure 7: Browser-use trajectories rendered as static video strips. Each row contains five chronologically ordered frames: (a) Hugging Face checkpoint and configuration verification; (b) GitHub repository and API-reliability investigation; and (c) PyTorch documentation and pinned-source inspection. Arrows indicate temporal progression. All panels show the browser interface itself without the presentation overlays used in the demo videos.
blocks.zh: 图7:作为静态视频条提供的浏览器-使用轨迹。 每行包含五个按时间顺序排列的帧:(a) 套头检查站和配置核查;(b) GitHub仓库和API可靠性调查;(c) PyTorch文档和绑定源检查。 箭头表示时间进展. 所有面板都显示浏览器界面本身,没有演示视频中使用的演示文稿覆盖.

blocks.en: Figure 7 shows three selected trajectories on public websites. The Hugging Face task identifies the standard Atria-Dawn-Preview checkpoint and verifies both its configuration and default-reasoning template. The GitHub task starts from repository search, enters the official project, and locates an API-reliability issue reporting intermittent HTTP 422 and 502/503 responses. The PyTorch task verifies the evaluation-time dropout warning for scaled_dot_product_attention and follows the documented API to its pinned v2.14 implementation. The three traces reach the requested evidence in 6, 6, and 4 local decisions, respectively. Median Intern-Decision inference latency is 101.6, 109.8, and 95.3 ms (server-reported inference time, excluding planning, network, and browser execution).
blocks.zh: 图7显示公共网站上的三个选定轨迹。 Hugging Face任务确定标准Atria-Dawn-Preview检查点,并验证其配置和默认理由模板. GitHub任务从寄存器搜索开始,进入正式项目,并定位一个API-可靠性问题,报告间歇性HTTP 422和502/503响应. PyTorch 任务验证了对缩放的_dot_product_attention的评价 - 时间退出警告,并遵循了文件记录的API 键入的 v2.14 执行 。 三个痕迹分别达到当地6、6和4项裁决中所要求的证据。 中级实习裁判推论延迟为101.6,109.8和95.3ms(服务器报告的推论时间,不包括规划,网络,浏览器执行).

blocks.en: These examples are qualitative system demonstrations rather than a browser benchmark. Dynamic pages can occasionally produce delayed or visually unchanged outcomes; the controller therefore re-observes the interface after every action and uses explicit completion checks to avoid unnecessary continuation. This division of labor lets the larger model handle goal decomposition and cross-page reasoning while Intern-Decision handles repeated, structured action selection.
blocks.zh: 这些例子是定性系统演示,而不是浏览器基准. 动态页面偶尔可以产生延迟或视觉上不变的结果;因此,控制器在每个动作后重新观察接口,并使用明确的完成检查以避免不必要的延续. 这种分工让更大的模型处理目标分解和跨页推理,而Intern-Decision则处理重复的,结构化的行动选择.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We introduce Intern-Decision, which makes finite multimodal choices through a single causal forward pass, retaining the pretrained backbone’s native language-model head and exposing candidate probabilities through a typed interface. The 4B model achieves the highest seven-suite average in the presented comparison, with a 44.16 ms mean for a fixed short request on an RTX 4090. Separate calibration and handoff studies show how probabilistic outputs can support uncertainty analysis and selective use of a larger model. We believe Intern-Decision can serve as a practical component of larger agent systems, but its generalization to arbitrarily large schemas and complex environments remains an open problem.
blocks.zh: 我们提出实习决定,通过单一的因果前传选择有限的多式联运方式,保留预先训练过的骨干本土语言模式头,并通过打字界面暴露候选人的概率。 4B型在所呈现的比较中实现了最高的七套平均,在RTX 4090型机上固定短请求的平均值为44.16 ms. 单独的校准和交接研究表明概率性输出如何能支持不确定性分析和有选择地使用更大的模型. 我们认为,实习决定可以作为更大的代理系统的一个实际组成部分,但将其概括为任意的大型计划和复杂的环境仍然是一个公开的问题。

blocks.en: Appendix A Release and Reproduction Details
blocks.zh: 附录A 发布和复制详情

blocks.en: The public implementation documentation inspected for this draft is fixed to Git revision 2f815802058b . It identifies ordinary next-token alignment for the masked skeleton; historical same-position masked experiments are separate revisions. The published accuracy and pilot tables use XTuner, while the reported local latency uses native Hugging Face inference. A checkpoint, tokenizer, processor, calibration artifact, and backend configuration together define an evaluated system.
blocks.zh: 这份草案所检查的公开执行文件已固定在Git 2f815802058b。 它为蒙面骨架识别普通的邻接吻对齐;历史的同位置蒙面实验是单独的修订. 公布的精度和试点表格使用XTuner,而报道的局部纬度则使用本土的Hugging Face推论. 一个检查点,标注器,处理器,校准文物,以及后端配置一起定义一个被评价的系统.

blocks.en: The released evaluation procedure consists of four stages. First, verify the bundled test hashes and counts. Second, bind the correct preset temperature to the exact checkpoint through metadata and weight-shard checks. Third, run uncalibrated inference and replay the fixed temperature on the saved probabilities, retaining complete raw outputs and verifying unchanged labels. blocks.en: The pilot consists of six categories with four families each. Every family has two settings and every setting has two option-order variants. The resulting 96 records cover the following mechanisms:

blocks.en: 1. Direct randomness and support: uniform die faces with impossible options; weighted candy inventories; deterministic single-color pens; rare winning lottery tickets. 2. Composed events and mixtures: sums of two dice; numbers of independent hits; independent backup generators; delivery outcomes under an unobserved route mixture. 3. History, conditioning, and hidden state: independent coin flips after a streak; socks after known removals; die outcomes given a restricted sensor observation; a two-state Markov process with noisy sensor readings. 4. Daily evidence and observation bias: defect screening with a stated base rate; conditionally independent repeated tests; correlated copies of one test; waiting times observed at a uniformly sampled time. 5. Selective disclosure and puzzles: informed-host Monty Hall; uninformed-host Monty Hall conditioned on a safe reveal; prize-dependent switch offers; two-child problems with different child-selection protocols. 6. Sequential and combinatorial processes: distinct coupons collected after finite draws; birthday collisions on a toy calendar; gambler’s ruin; first-reward times with a guaranteed stopping limit.
